question: What provider-aware buckets should `/context detail` use for Codex usage, and which buckets should count toward context-window pressure versus billing-only usage?
rationale: Current code can expose tracked prompt and Codex token fields, but the exact meaning of the residual requires maintainer/provider intent before changing user-facing diagnostics or compaction semantics.

options.title: Define Ledger Buckets
